about_the_game:
Take the wheel of an old Tavria and embark on an endless adventure on Ukrainian survival roads

In Rust Rides, you will find a realistic survival simulator with no plot restrictions, where the world is built to suit your decisions. You start with almost nothing - just your own car, some gasoline, and the ability to trade. The road opens up unlimited possibilities: trade scrap metal, nuts, feathers, or cars with ordinary NPCs to pave your way to success. Every kilometer is a chance for a new story, and every gas station is a chance for survival.

Collect and upgrade cars from the Ukrainian car industry - from the humble Tavria to rare retro models. Buy cheap spare parts and turn old cars into a profitable business by upgrading their power and style. Upgrading is not just about technology: improve your character's driving, repair, and survival skills. Expand your home from a shack to a comfortable base. Each dawn brings new challenges and opens up the boundless world of Ukraine - from quiet country roads to noisy auctions.

Game features:

  • Collecting and modifying cars, including models of the Ukrainian car industry.

  • Purchase and resale of goods from regular NPCs (ferrous metal, feathers, nuts, cars, etc.) to earn money.

  • An open world without a storyline with key locations: scrap metal, car dealership, auction, and an expandable player's house.

  • Equipment and character upgrades (various survival, crafting, and driving skills).

  • A real sandbox with almost endless potential for development and adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4150
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050Ti 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Disk: HDD
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3080 10GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Disk: SSD

short_description: Realistic sandbox simulator in the open world of Ukraine. Buy, collect and upgrade cars, trade metal, nuts and feathers, develop your base and character. Play without a plot and restrictions. Built on Unreal Engine 5.5 for maximum freedom and atmosphere.
